narratives.Overview:
<!-- deft-nightly-lane: windows -->
This issue tracks the **Nightly full suite (Windows)** lane of the nightly workflow (`.github/workflows/nightly.yml`). The workflow reopens it and comments when the lane is red, and comments and closes it when the lane passes. Release readiness reuses a lane only when its latest attempt succeeded on the release tree (docs/RELEASING.md).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `packages/runtime/scripts/pack-staged-runtime.mjs` runs its four tar calls (extract, repack, `-xOf`, `-tzf`) in the tarball's folder with the archive file name only, and uses System32 bsdtar on win32, the same way `tasks/materialize.cjs` does (#6703).
- [ ] A test proves the win32 tar invocation: System32 `tar.exe`, the tarball's folder as cwd, and a bare archive name with no drive letter.
